items.reference: tools/selfcheck-attack.js food AI energy and macro checks
items.reason: Replaced expectations that calories generate macros or inconsistent values are silently normalized. FOOD-004 requires preserving missing fields and reported disagreement.

items.reference: tools/selfcheck-attack.js water, profile, weight, and running checks
items.reason: Scalar and optimistic UI expectations were replaced with date-keyed canonical records, explicit provenance, timezone context, and commit-before-acknowledgement checks.
Immediate copied-meal writes conflict with FoodDraft/MealRecord separation. The harness now requires explicit user confirmation before a MealRecord exists.
Assertions now preserve AI model uncertainty, missing nutrient fields, and unmodified calorie/macro disagreement as required by FOOD-004 and FOOD-006.

items.reference: tools/selfcheck-attack.js D9 plus tools/selfcheck-functional.js G4 food interactions
items.reason: Added app-level latest-result-wins and close-cancellation coverage, then verified draft persistence, explicit confirmation, canonical export, field provenance, and photo exclusion.
The functional harness closes its JSDOM window after assertions so the app's recurring UI timer cannot block the aggregate regression runner. No production timing changed.
Both offline evaluators now extract the production item sanitizer required by sanitizeVision. This repairs the harness boundary without changing app behavior.

items.reference: tools/selfcheck-attack.js Q3 historical service-worker cache literal
items.reason: The old V1 cache name is not a valid V2 RC expectation. The replacement check verifies the V2 RC namespace and cleanup limited to managed V2 prefixes.
